<noinclude>This is a template for rendering simple [[wikipedia:family tree|family trees]] consisting of boxes and connecting lines based on an [[wikipedia:ASCII art|ASCII art]]-like syntax.  The trees are displayed as [[wikipedia:HTML|HTML]] tables using [[wikipedia:Cascading Style Sheets|CSS]] attributes, and may contain what appears to be arbitrary [[wikipedia:wiki markup|wiki markup]] within the boxes.  See [[wikipedia:Template talk:Familytree|the talk page on Wikipedia]] for documentation and example usage.

<!-- DO NOT EDIT BELOW THIS LINE UNLESS YOU KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING! -->
</noinclude><includeonly>{{familytree/step2
